name: Typing Practice
description: Type a passage for one minute: per-character feedback, accuracy and speed, with short unlockable stages and personal bests kept on this device
help: Practice with built-in passages or paste your own text; timing starts with the first committed character, stops when the window loses focus or you pause, and continues when you resume.
Each character is marked correct, wrong or pending. Backspace corrects text, but wrong attempts stay counted; uncorrected errors are shown separately.
Counting uses visible characters: an emoji or an accented letter is one character. Punctuation, spaces and line breaks are compared as-is; nothing is substituted.
Chinese IME composition is not counted until committed; committing several characters at once counts each one and is not treated as a paste.
Accuracy = (all attempts − wrong attempts) ÷ all attempts; CPM = correct characters ÷ active minutes; English WPM = CPM ÷ 5. No speed is shown without input or time.
Stage goal: finish the passage with at least 90% accuracy to unlock the next stage. Bests are kept per source + language + mode + text version.
A round with pasted or dropped text is practice only: no personal best and no stage unlock. All data stays in ToolForge on this device.

typing.noBest: No record yet. Finish a round to save one.
typing.pasteNotice: Paste detected: this round is practice only and won't be saved
typing.customPlaceholder: Paste or type the text you want to practice (kept on this device only)
typing.stageFailed: Finished, but accuracy is below the goal. Try again
typing.finished: Round over. Press Restart to go again
typing.clearConfirm: Click again to clear bests, stage progress and mistakes (custom and drill texts are kept)
typing.drillHint: Generated from your frequent mistakes and kept separately from your custom text
typing.formula: Accuracy = (attempts − wrong attempts) ÷ attempts, corrected errors still count; CPM = correct characters ÷ active minutes; visible characters are counted
typing.formulaEn: Accuracy = (attempts − wrong attempts) ÷ attempts, corrected errors still count; CPM = correct characters ÷ active minutes; WPM = CPM ÷ 5
typing.saveSummary: Save practice summary to a file

score.summary: Score one typing submission: per-character result, accuracy and speed
score.target: Target text to compare against (positional; may come from stdin)
score.typed: Full text currently in the practice area
score.elapsedMs: Active input time in milliseconds, excluding pauses
score.pasted: Whether this submission came from a paste (pasted rounds are not saved as records)
score.session: Cumulative state from the previous call as a JSON string; may be omitted on the first call
score.prev: Previously submitted text, empty for a new round; new attempts are derived from the difference

drill.summary: Generate reproducible drill text from frequently mistyped characters
drill.chars: Characters to drill (positional; may come from stdin)
drill.len: Number of output characters, at most 2000
drill.seed: Random seed; the same input and seed give the same text
